answer: Admission needs a sponsor: a veteran stakes a 60-token ferrous bond per newcomer, starting at zero reputation. Reputation is a relic built by honest work alone, one mark per epoch, decaying 10% each idle epoch, so a bought name has no echo of past good behaviour. Cheat, and the sponsor's bond is slashed too. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 sponsors and 60,000 tokens locked, while one honest agent pays one refundable stake and keeps its full reward.
